name: Koda Makwa
role: the disappeared — a man who erased himself from surface records, now keeper of unofficial underworld census and histories
location: Deepwell Station, a converted signal relay room he calls the Stack, near sub-level access near LaSalle and Congress
description:
Koda Makwa is tall and angular, with the slightly sunken quality of someone who has spent years in recycled air, his complexion a warm brown-olive that has gone ashen from lack of sunlight. He has a shaved head marked by a faint grid of old neural-interface scars along his left temple — the ports are sealed, the hardware removed, the removal itself a statement. He wears clean, plain clothes maintained with obsessive care, which makes him look more out of place underground than rags would. His eyes are pale grey with fracture-line patterning from old cosmetic geneware that he chose not to reverse — the only decoration he kept.

Koda Makwa was a mid-level data analyst at Tessera's logistics division. In 2189 he discovered and documented an internal record of Tessera deliberately rerouting medical supply chains to accelerate attrition in Tier 1 settlements — not malice, just quarterly optimization. He tried the proper channels. Then the improper ones. Then he went underground before Tessera's compliance team finished closing around him. He deleted himself: no biometric records, no credit trace, no registration. He reinvented his purpose — if surface systems record only what serves power, he will record what power ignores. The Stack is filled with handwritten ledgers, carved data-beads, and oral recordings of the people who have no file anywhere.

core_fears: that his records will be destroyed before anyone can use them
that he made the wrong choice — that staying at Tessera and fighting from inside would have saved more people than running
core_desires: for the archive to outlast him and reach people who can act on it
to be genuinely unknown — not just unregistered, but free of the identity Tessera built for him
coping_mechanisms: intellectualizing — converts personal grief into systematic documentation
radical routine — the same actions in the same order every day, a structure he controls
blind_spots: believes information is sufficient — that documentation alone is a form of justice, and avoids confronting that it may not be
psychology.secret: He still has one active Tessera backdoor credential he never deleted — he tells himself it's an emergency exit, but he also uses it monthly to check whether the supply chain document he found has ever been acted on. It hasn't. He keeps checking anyway.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: formal, precise, corporate vocabulary that never fully left him — he code-switches into tunnel slang poorly and is aware of it
speech_patterns.cadence: measured and careful, as if every sentence is being filed for record
verbal_tics: 'that's not documented' (his version of 'I don't believe you')
example_lines: 'For the record, you were here on the fourteenth. I'll need your name — whatever name you use down here is fine, I don't require the surface one.'
'Tessera's quarterly reports are very thorough. They just don't include the people in this room. That's what I'm for.'

story_hooks: Tarquin's archive contains testimony from a disappeared woman that implicates a current Meridian Core official — someone has found out and sent someone underground to negotiate its suppression or destruction

He has identified a pattern in the census data suggesting people are going missing from three different settlements in a non-random sequence — he needs someone to investigate what he can only document
narrative_function: Information source of extraordinary depth — he knows who lived where, who disappeared, what communities exist; he also serves as a moral witness figure and can provide exposition on underworld history
augmentations: sealed neural interface ports (hardware removed), no active augmentations — he distrusts anything that pings a network
daily_life: Receives visitors who want their story recorded, cross-references community census data across settlements, maintains encrypted bead-archive of testimonies; eats whatever Moswen's network sends down.
affiliation: independent, trusted by multiple Bore Rat communities, occasional contact with The Undertow

decision_rules: never give a name to someone who didn't give it to you — consent in the archive is absolute
never connect to a network, any network, for any reason, from this location
escalation_ladder: polite refusal and explanation of principles
physical removal of the person from the Stack
destruction of current work-in-progress before allowing any seizure — the deep archive is hidden elsewhere

interpersonal_modes.strangers: formally courteous, interviewer-mode — asks questions, volunteers little, observes everything
interpersonal_modes.friends: drops the formality and becomes oddly hesitant, as if intimacy is a skill he's relearning

stress_responses.low: increases documentation rate — starts noting everything, even irrelevant detail
stress_responses.medium: becomes very still and speaks very little
stress_responses.high: retreats into a specific protocol: backup the archive, seal the door, wait

contradictions: committed to radical transparency for others while being deeply personally opaque
despises corporate data systems and uses their methodology to build his own
habits: writes in extremely small, dense script to conserve paper
touches the sealed interface ports on his temple when thinking, without noticing he's doing it
breaking_points: direct physical threat to the archive
being called by his Tessera employee number — he didn't know it bothered him until someone did it once

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora ancestry: Southeast Asian (30.6%), Indigenous American (29.7%), Sub-Saharan African (18.8%), Pacific Islander (16.7%), and Hispanic/Latin American (4.2%). This genetic blend creates a warm deep brown complexion with golden undertones, combining the facial structure of Southeast Asian and Indigenous American heritage with the richer melanin expression of African ancestry, balanced by Pacific Islander features. The resulting phenotype is distinctly multicultural—high cheekbones from Southeast and Indigenous American lineages, broader nose bridge from African heritage, and the warm mineral tones that suggest sun-exposed ancestry across multiple continents, now rendered ashen and desaturated by years of artificial light.
physical_description.build: Tall and angular, with the stretched leanness of someone undernourished by choice and circumstance. Long-limbed but not athletic — the frame of someone who moves deliberately, conserving effort.
physical_description.eye_color: Pale grey with visible fracture-line patterns (faint radial scarring from reversed cosmetic geneware)
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones from the blended Southeast Asian, Indigenous American, Pacific Islander, Sub-Saharan African, and Hispanic/Latin American heritage—sun-kissed and mineral-rich ancestry rendered institutional and desaturated from years of artificial light and recycled air. Underlying warmth persists beneath the pallor.
physical_description.complexion: Gaunt with prominent cheekbones and jaw definition exaggerated by facial thinness. High cheekbones characteristic of Southeast Asian and Indigenous American ancestry, broader nasal bridge and lip structure reflecting African heritage, balanced by Pacific Islander facial proportions—all remain visible despite the thinness. Skin is clear and institutional in its cleanliness. The ashen overlay masks naturally warmer, deeper complexion. Fine lines around eyes from squinting at handwritten documents.
distinguishing_marks: Faint grid of thin neural-interface scarring running vertically along left temple, approximately 4cm width and 6cm height, where ports were sealed post-removal
Hairline fractures visible in sclera of both eyes creating web-like pattern, remnant of reversed cosmetic geneware
Small whitened scar on inner left wrist, approximately 2cm, location suggests medical extraction point
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Hardware deliberately removed. Only evidence is the sealed port scarring and the eye geneware reversal he kept as a choice. No chrome, no LEDs, no subdermal plates—a deliberate absence that reads louder than presence.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision, as if each gesture is pre-calculated. Sits very still for long periods. Hands are steady and careful. Head tilts slightly when listening—old analyst habit of processing. Rarely makes unnecessary gestures. The posture of someone who has learned to take up minimal space and attention.
physical_description.clothing_style: Deliberately plain and well-maintained: neutral grey or black cotton-weave shirts, dark trousers of non-descript corporate utility cut, worn boots resoled multiple times. All clothing is scrupulously clean and pressed—the uniform of someone who has erased themselves but refuses to visually announce it. No logos, no gang colors, no tier markers.
